caption: The drawing depicts a metal teapot with a conical lid. The surface of the teapot is painted primarily in reddish-brown with decorative yellowish-gold swirls and accents. There is a painted motif on the body of the teapot featuring various fruits, including a yellow pear, purple grapes, and possibly green leaves and another piece of fruit, rendered with some shading and blending of colors. The spout is long and narrow, pointing to the left, and is the same reddish-brown shade as the body. The handle is large and curved, attached to the right side, and also shares the reddish-brown coloring. The lid is painted green with a red band near the base and has additional decorative yellow and red markings. The teapot is centered on a plain, light beige background with no other objects or details present.
title: Toleware Coffee Pot
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
